package domain_test

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func validLearningActionClosure() domain.LearningActionClosed {
	return domain.LearningActionClosed{
		EventID:          "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID:        "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CorrelationID:    "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		CausationID:      "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningActionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		ContextType:      domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:        "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{
			{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: " learning.semantic-sequence ", Version: " v1 "},
		},
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func TestNewLearningActionClosedNormalizesTargetSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	closure, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosed(validLearningActionClosure())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, closure.LearningActionID, closure.CorrelationID)
	require.Equal(t, "learning.semantic-sequence", closure.LearningTargets[0].Key)
	require.Equal(t, "v1", closure.LearningTargets[0].Version)
}

func TestNewLearningActionClosedAllowsLegacyActionWithoutTargets(t *testing.T) {
	input := validLearningActionClosure()
	input.LearningTargets = nil
	closure, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosed(input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, closure.LearningTargets)
}

func TestNewLearningActionClosedRejectsMismatchedCorrelation(t *testing.T) {
	input := validLearningActionClosure()
	input.CorrelationID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	_, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosed(input)
	require.Error(t, err)
}
